# Ryujinx shader translator (vendored subset)

Three projects from Ryubing Canary-1.3.351 (commit 475615f0431b4995b03c930c5089d20f6f3570e0, https://git.ryujinx.app/ryubing/ryujinx.git): `Ryujinx.Graphics.Shader`, `Ryujinx.Common` and `Spv.Generator`. `Ryujinx.Common` and `Spv.Generator` are unmodified; `Ryujinx.Graphics.Shader` carries the local changes in `nxnative-local.patch` (15 files, 245 lines added and 29 removed), which are these:

- `Ryujinx.Graphics.Shader/CodeGen/Spirv/Instructions.cs`, `GenerateTextureSample`:
  - Texel offsets that are not constants (Maxwell AOFFI / TLD4.PTP offsets read from a register) are built with `OpCompositeConstruct` and passed as `Offset`. A four-offset gather becomes four one-offset gathers, each giving component w. Upstream wrote them as an `OpConstantComposite` with `ConstOffset(s)`, which is invalid SPIR-V; SPIRV-Cross threw `nullptr` and the shader never built (2026-10-18: 8 shaders in Wonder, Link's Awakening, Tears of the Kingdom and Age of Calamity). Marked `nxnative:` in the code.
  - Texture coordinates that are NaN are replaced by 0 (the `nfZero` select). This came with the first import.
- `Ryujinx.Graphics.Shader/Translation/Optimizations/BindlessElimination.cs`, `TryGetOperation` / `IsSameOperand`: a bindless handle that reaches the texture instruction through a phi is followed through the phis that feed it (a handle kept in a loop variable comes back through the loop's own phi), and two `constant buffer | constant` handles count as the same value. Upstream compared only the phi's direct inputs, so such handles fell to the texture-pool array of 32 (`*_t2d_cb0_40000000`), which cannot be bound; 218 pixel shaders in Monster Hunter Rise (2026-10-20). Marked `nxnative:` in the code.

- `Ryujinx.Graphics.Shader/Instructions/InstEmitTexture.cs`, `EmitTex` (TLD 1D with integer coordinates only) and `EmitTexs` (TLDS `Texture1DLodZero`), with `IGpuAccessor.RecordTexelFetch1D`: Maxwell reads a 1D texture and a texture buffer with the same instruction, and the bound descriptor decides. When the texture type query does not answer "buffer", the read is translated as 2D at `(x & 0x3FFF, x >> 14)` instead of `(x, 0)`, and the handle is reported. A 1D texture (one row at most 16384 wide on the host) reads the same; the host binds a texture buffer in such a slot as a linear 2D texture of 16384-texel rows over its memory (`nvn_mtl.m` `tbuf_as_2d`). Upstream read `(x, 0)` and the host had only a dummy texture to give: the light and decal lists of Age of Calamity (at least 15,000 shaders) and Three Houses read zeros (2026-10-21). Marked `nxnative:` in the code.

- `Ryujinx.Graphics.Shader/StructuredIr/AstOptimizer.cs`, `Optimize` / `UsedByCall`: a local that a call takes as an argument is not propagated. For SPIR-V, `StructuredProgram` copies every call argument into a local (SPIR-V passes them by pointer); propagating that local's expression into the call and removing the local left the call with a local no declaration made, and `CodeGen/Spirv` `GetLocalPointer` threw `KeyNotFoundException`: 1,894 of Viractal's 25,464 shaders, nearly all pixel shaders, did not translate (2026-10-25, the Android port). Marked `nxnative:` in the code. Not yet in `dm/gfx/tools/dmsh_xlate_bin`, which is rebuilt on a Mac with `dmsh_chain.py --update-lock`; the Android port builds the translator from this source. `StructuredIr/StructuredProgram.cs` passes the target language to `Optimize` for it (unmarked).

- `Ryujinx.Graphics.Shader/Instructions/InstEmitFlowControl.cs`: an indirect branch (BRX) always takes the sequential branches, not the chained form, whose structured program lost the jumps to the next case (Xenoblade Chronicles 3's movie shader: vertical stripes over every movie). Marked `nxnative:` in the code.

- `Ryujinx.Graphics.Shader/Translation/TranslatorContext.cs` `Translate` and `AttributeUsage.cs` `SetPassthroughWithoutNextStage`: a passthrough geometry shader translated alone (dmsh_xlate translates each shader by itself) for a host without passthrough forwards the first 16 attributes, as Maxwell forwards every attribute it does not write; it forwarded none, so the fragment shader's inputs went unwritten (Xenoblade Chronicles 3's effect layer; Adreno refused the pipelines). Marked `nxnative:` in the code.

- A geometry shader run as compute with a fixed input layout, for the offline Metal geometry path (`dm/gfx/tools/dmsh_geometry.py`, which dmsh_xlate turns on through `IGpuAccessor.QueryGeometryInputFixed`, default false). These hunks carry no `nxnative:` marker; a re-vendor should check each against the new base:
  - `IGpuAccessor.cs`: `QueryGeometryInputFixed()` (commented, not marked), beside the marked `RecordTexelFetch1D`.
  - `Translation/ResourceReservations.cs`: `GeometryInputFixed`, and `FillGeometryInputMap`, the input offsets of the Maxwell attribute map (position, point size, clip distances, layer, viewport, 32 user attributes; 144 words) in place of the offsets the next stage would give.
  - `Translation/ResourceManager.cs`: a `local_geometry_primitive_open` local when the input is fixed.
  - `Translation/EmitterContext.cs`: with a fixed input, the output vertex data starts at zero, with w (and point size) at one; the index buffer stride and the vertex count come from the fixed-input stride and `GeometryCounts`.
  - `Translation/EmitterContextInsts.cs`: `EmitVertex` stops at the shader's maximum output vertex count, and `EndPrimitive` ends only a primitive that has a vertex.
  - `Translation/ShaderDefinitions.cs`: the fixed-input index buffer stride is two indices per output vertex (one restart per vertex at most).
  - `Translation/Transforms/GeometryToCompute.cs`: the output index offsets use that stride; the primitive ID is the global ID, with `GeometryCounts` for the output index.
  - `Translation/TranslatorContext.cs` `CreateDefinitions`: a compute workgroup of 32 × 1 with a fixed input (32 × 32 otherwise).

## Re-vendoring

Check out the three projects of the new base (`git clone --filter=blob:none --sparse`, then `git sparse-checkout set src/Ryujinx.Graphics.Shader src/Ryujinx.Common src/Spv.Generator`, with `core.autocrlf=false`), copy them over `src/`, and from the repository root run `git apply --directory=nxnative/dm/third_party/ryujinx nxnative/dm/third_party/ryujinx/nxnative-local.patch`. Fix any hunk that no longer applies, drop the ones upstream now has, then make the patch again against the new base (`git diff --no-index --binary` of the base's three folders and these, with the paths made relative to this folder: `a/src/…`, `b/src/…`) and update the base above.

The shader translation tool in `dm/gfx/tools/dmsh_xlate` references them to translate the original Switch shaders to SPIR-V.
